notes:
## New features
- New splash screen. A redesigned start-up card with new artwork, the AURIS logo and text laid out to the brand guidelines, a soft outer shadow, and a slim teal progress bar. It opens centred on your screen and can be dragged. After an update it turns cyan throughout, so you can see at a glance that AURIS is finishing an update.
- Brand colours in the colour picker. The AURIS colour library now holds the brand colours (Auris Teal, Auris Bright, Auris Black, Auris White) and the brand palette, with each colour's name and hex code on hover.

## Changes
- A shorter splash display reduces the wait on fast starts. It shows for at least 3 seconds from when it appears, long enough to see what is opening, while start-up work carries on underneath; progress shows the real start-up stages; and the splash fades into the main window.
- The splash light and progress animations run on the graphics thread, so they stay smooth while AURIS is busy starting up.
- The 3D view shows "Preparing 3D view..." while it builds the first time, and the basemap is prepared in the background after a project opens.
- Brighter direct sunlight in the 3D view, for clearer contrast between sunlit and shaded surfaces.
- Toggle switches show a pointing hand, slide with a smoother eased motion, and use the AURIS teal.
- Contour sheet neatline labels have the same weight on all four sides.
- The splash artwork is positioned to keep the warm lower streak outside the crop, with yellow highlights neutralised in both the teal and cyan versions.

## Bug fixes
- Switching to the 3D view could freeze AURIS for several seconds, or minutes on large scenes with detailed contours, and again on later refreshes.
- Most toggle switches changed instantly instead of animating.
- Very large basemaps were decoded again every time the 3D view was built.
- A single carriageway could be drawn with three or four lanes in 2D and 3D when it was wide; it now always shows two lanes (one each way).
- The splash progress bar could show a thin squared sliver at low progress; it now starts as a circle and grows with round caps.
- The splash shadow could show sharp rectangular corners beneath the animated artwork; it now follows the rounded card throughout.
- The cyan splash says "Updating to" while an update is in progress and "Updated to" on the first launch after installation.
- Reopening a project in the same window could leave the saved contours invisible in the view and exported sheet; the display is now restored from the saved grid.
